paper.title: Gradient-Flow SDEs Have Unique Transient Population Dynamics
paper.authors: Vincent Guan, Joseph Janssen, Nicolas Lanzetti, Antonio Terpin, Geoffrey Schiebinger, Elina Robeva
paper.system: Section 5.1 Styblinski-Tang gradient flow, three marginals, neural potential drift, scalar diffusivity

H1_drift.note: On held-out particle states. Residual RMS is reported and is not a gate. A pass is not the Styblinski cubic.

H2_diffusion.note: H2_distill compares the polynomial to the scalar teacher. H2_truth requires relative error at most 0.20. The seed-18 prior is already 0.37 away, and the true-path MLE on the probe is 0.01 away, so 0.20 asks the iteration to move the prior. The grid factor flags a local shadow and is not itself the pass.

H3_collinearity_gate.note: Degree-3 free library, constant column excluded, fit on train queries. Passing the gate is not permission to read the cubic as -2 x^3 + 16 x - 2.5.

H4_simulation.note: Two Euler steps, shared Wiener increments, test initial states. Failure above the rate gate makes H4 indeterminate. The drift gate stops a short path from passing while the field is wrong.

H5_law.note: Independent draws from the same realized mixture. If the truth-vs-truth floor exceeds the teacher gate, H5 is indeterminate. Terminal covariance is scored even when the mean path is below the floor.

H6_shuffle_and_grid.note: Shuffle permutes y independently. The grid is [-4,4]^2, 11 by 11, and is not used for selection. Amplification is recorded when the grid RMS exceeds twice the on-trajectory residual RMS.

H7_discretization.note: Teacher drift, dt=0.01 versus one Euler step of dt=0.02 with the summed normalized Gaussian increment. The probe truth gap was 0.148, so the gate is 0.40 rather than the truncation itself.

H8_fixed_diffusion.note: The fixed run keeps the Section 5.1 prior and still refits the drift. Both numbers are test-set NRMSE against the true drift. The adaptive model must be inside 0.45 and at least 0.05 better.

threshold_basis.note: Truth-only probe, seed 18099, before the evaluation seed is trained. The degree-3 library matches the Styblinski drift to 1e-15. Probe VIF 15.3 is already above the gate of 10; the gate is not raised. The seed-18 prior has relative error 0.371, so H2_truth at 0.20 is not passed by the prior. The truth Euler gap at dt=0.02 is 0.148, so H7 is 0.40. Thresholds are not revised after test.
